summary.en-US: Peer to peer messenger, no company server

description.en-US:
MindTheClub is a messenger that carries messages straight from one phone to the
other. There is no company server storing your chats, and no phone number is
needed to sign up.

This build is made for phones without Google services. Notifications arrive
through UnifiedPush, so a distributor such as ntfy has to be installed.

* Text, photos, videos, files and voice calls, end to end encrypted
* Groups, with messages relayed between members
* Bluetooth as an alternative transport when there is no network
* Encrypted backup that carries your identity to a new phone

The app is free to try for 30 days. After that it needs a subscription, bought
on the web and activated inside the app.
